headline: Agentic QA moves into simulation and IDEs; AI PR scanning broadens; observability and infra changes affect test reliability

top_signal.title: NVIDIA demonstrates agentic workflows to prepare 3D scenes for simulation
top_signal.summary: NVIDIA shows agentic workflows that inspect Blender scenes, tag assets, generate metadata, and export sim-ready sensor outputs — enabling automated creation and validation of simulation environments used for robotics and perception testing.
top_signal.why_it_matters: Automates test-scene and sensor-data generation, improving reproducibility and scaling system-in-the-loop QA for perception and embodied AI systems.

items.title: GitHub AI Scan no longer requires CodeQL default setup
items.summary: GitHub’s AI Scan now runs across eligible repositories even when the CodeQL default setup isn’t configured, widening PR-level AI scanning without a full CodeQL repo configuration step.
items.why_it_matters: QA teams can adopt AI-powered PR scanning faster, but must tune evaluation and triage workflows to manage false positives and align fixes with existing CodeQL pipelines.

items.title: Rider & ReSharper 2026.2.2 add AI Agent Setup widget and agent-focused hooks
items.summary: JetBrains’ Rider and ReSharper add an AI Agent Setup widget and file-inspection scoping for agents, improving in-IDE agent integration for multi-step code edits, test scaffolding, and debugging flows.
items.why_it_matters: Simplifies configuring coding agents for test generation and in-IDE debugging, reducing friction when adopting agentic QA workflows and generating developer-facing test scaffolds.

items.title: OpenTelemetry plugin auto-maps microservices in JetBrains IDEs
items.summary: JetBrains’ OpenTelemetry plugin auto-generates real-time service maps from traces, logs, and metrics and surfaces them in the IDE, giving developers and testers an up-to-date call graph without separate tooling.
items.why_it_matters: Enables faster root-cause analysis for failing tests by correlating traces and failures in the IDE, reducing MTTR for flaky or integration test failures.

watch.title: Kubernetes v1.37 graduates Pod-Level Resource Managers to Beta
watch.summary: Kubernetes 1.37 moves Pod-Level Resource Managers to Beta (feature gate) so kubelet can use Pod-level resource declarations for NUMA-aware CPU/memory placement, changing scheduling and placement behavior on nodes.
watch.why_it_matters: Test infra teams should validate CI and device-farm node behavior—scheduling changes can shift performance characteristics and increase flaky test surface on resource-constrained runners.

learning.title: Logpoints Walkthrough — using log-only breakpoints to gather runtime evidence
learning.summary: JetBrains documents using logpoints (log-only breakpoints) to capture runtime values without pausing execution, enabling continuous capture of diagnostic data during long-running or high-throughput test runs.
learning.why_it_matters: Logpoints let QA collect low-overhead evidence from CI and ephemeral environments, improving flaky-test triage and post-failure analysis without interrupting test execution.
